title: Windows desktop client: native kith app for Windows
description:
A native desktop client for kith on Windows.

Scope:
- Connect to user's kithd over tailnet (tailscaled already running on Windows)
- Contact list, chat list, message thread (1:1 and group)
- Send/receive messages; read receipts; attachment upload/download
- Windows toast notifications (WinRT notification APIs)
- System tray icon with unread count
- EventSource for live push
- Windows file explorer integration for attachment save/open
- Target: Tauri (Rust + WebView2, natural fit on Windows) OR WinUI 3 for fully native feel; decide in research phase
- Distribution: .msi / MSIX installer; Microsoft Store submission optional
